title.en: Prepositions of place: at, on, in

focus.en: In for inside a space or area (in the drawer, in Mississauga, in a meeting); on for a surface, a floor or a list (on the desk, on the fourth floor); at for a point or a place where something happens (at the front desk, at 250 Bay Street, at work).
focus.uk: In — усередині простору чи місцевості (in the drawer, in Mississauga, in a meeting); on — на поверхні, поверсі чи у списку (on the desk, on the fourth floor); at — у точці чи місці, де щось відбувається (at the front desk, at 250 Bay Street, at work).

exercises.text: The files are ___ the top drawer of my desk.
exercises.uk: Документи у верхній шухляді мого столу.

exercises.text: There's a sticky note ___ your monitor.
I'll meet you ___ the front desk.
Our office is ___ the fourth floor.
The company is located ___ 250 Bay Street.

why.en: A full address with a number takes at; a street alone takes on (on Bay Street).
why.uk: Повна адреса з номером вимагає at; сама вулиця — on (on Bay Street).

why.en: People and things shown in a picture: in.
why.uk: Люди й речі на зображенні: in.

why.en: Lists take on (on the list, on the agenda).
why.uk: Списки вимагають on (on the list, on the agenda).

exercises.text: Sorry, Mr. Patel is ___ a meeting until two.
exercises.uk: Перепрошую, пан Патель на нараді до другої.

why.en: In a meeting = taking part in it.
why.uk: In a meeting = бере в ній участь.

why.en: At work, at home, at school: fixed phrases with at.
why.uk: At work, at home, at school: сталі фрази з at.
